outcome: Blood flow score around the gestational sac
cohort: 69 women with a live tubal ectopic pregnancy (TEP) and 54 with a cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSP) at 6-11 weeks of gestation.
finding: The rate of a fetus with a cardiac activity was significantly higher in CSPs than in TEPs, and the slow development of the gestation sac was more pronounced in TEPs, likely due to limited access to decidual gland secretions.
